text: Spring registration among continuing students is running 4.8% below the same point last year, when 125 continuing students had registered as of 2025-11-20 [M1]. Registered credit hours are down 2.7% compared with the prior year's 1872 hours [M7]. There are 42 continuing students who have not yet registered, and each is a person we can still reach with advising and support before the term begins [M2].
